**Nexo v0.4 beta 4** removes the yellow border some of you saw around a window while sharing it. Nexo
updates itself: look for the **Restart to update** banner.

> **Hosts:** nothing to do, the server didn't change.

## What's new

- **No yellow border while sharing.** On some PCs, sharing a window or screen with the **Native** capture
  engine (the default on Windows) drew a yellow border around it, which the **Chromium** engine didn't.
  The Native engine now turns that border off the same way Chromium does. If you still see it, check
  **Windows Settings → Privacy & security → Screenshot borders**: when apps aren't allowed to turn the
  border off, it shows for every app. (The border can't be turned off on Windows 10.)

## Install

Already on v0.2.0-alpha.1 or later? Nothing to do: Nexo updates itself.

On a **test build** (v0.4.0-test.x)? Go to **Settings → App → Updates → Leave test builds**, then restart
Nexo. Test builds only update to newer test builds.

New here? Download the file for your system from the **Assets** below, then see the
[user guide](https://github.com/campiohe/nexo/blob/main/docs/USER-GUIDE.md#install). The installers are
**not code-signed**, so your OS will warn you the first time (on Windows: **More info → Run anyway**).
